title: Hi-Fi Gibson Assembly
author: NUS iGEM
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8abhsan

steps.title: Calculate fragment volumes
steps.instruction: Determine the volume of each DNA fragment to be assembled based on its length and concentration, using the provided calculation method.

steps.title: Add DNA fragments
steps.instruction: Add the calculated volume of each fragment to the PCR tube, ensuring that the total volume of fragments does not exceed 5 µL.

steps.title: Add assembly master mix
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL of 2× Hi‑Fi DNA Assembly Master Mix (NEBuilder HiFi DNA Assembly Master Mix, 10‑rxn, New England Biolabs, Cat. #E2621S) to the PCR tube.

substeps.instruction: Vortex briefly to mix the contents
Spin down the tube to collect the mixture at the bottom

steps.title: Incubate assembly
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction at 50 °C for 45 minutes (00:45:00).
